description_en: Updates the name of a collector
name: UpdateCollectorName

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must ensure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The updated name of the collector
parameters.name: body

collectorPaths.description_en: The collection path of Filebeat. This parameter is displayed when the collector is deployed on an ECS instance
collectorPaths.description_zh: fileBeat采集路径。当采集器的部署机器为ECS时显示

items.description_en: The collection path of Filebeat. This parameter is displayed when the collector is deployed on an ECS instance
items.description_zh: fileBeat采集路径。当采集器的部署机器为ECS时显示

configs.description_en: The configuration file information of the collector
configs.description_zh: 采集器的配置文件信息

content.example:
- key: log
 title: Log file content
 description: >
 Contains log file lines.
 ....

dryRun.description_en:
Specifies whether to verify and update the collector. Valid values:

true: only verifies the request without updating the collector.
false: verifies and updates the collector
dryRun.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器。支持：

true：只校验不更新
false：校验并更新

extendConfigs.description_en: The extended configurations of the collector

configType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

collectorTargetInstance: the output of the collector
collectorDeployMachine: the machine where the collector is deployed
collectorElasticsearchForKibana: the information about the Elasticsearch instance that supports Kibana Dashboard
configType.description_zh:
配置类型。支持：

collectorTargetInstance：采集器Output
collectorDeployMachine：采集器的部署机器
collectorElasticsearchForKibana：支持Kibana仪表盘的Elasticsearch实例信息

enableMonitoring.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable monitoring. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance and instanceType is set to elasticsearch. Valid values:

true: enables monitoring.
false: disables monitoring
enableMonitoring.description_zh:
是否启用Monitoring。当configType为collectorTargetInstance，且instanceType为elasticsearch时显示。支持：

true：启用
false：不启用

groupId.description_en: The ID of the machine group. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine

host.description_en: The internal-facing access address of Kibana on the private network after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorElasticsearchForKibana
host.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的私网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

hosts.description_en: The access endpoints of the instance specified by the collector output. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
hosts.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

items.description_en: The access endpoints of the instance specified by the collector output. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
items.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

instanceId.description_en: Instance ID of the instance associated with the collector. If configType is set to collectorTargetInstance, this parameter indicates instance ID of the instance specified by the collector output. If configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ACKCluster, this parameter indicates instance ID of the ACK cluster
instanceId.description_zh: 采集器关联的实例ID。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时，为采集器Output的实例ID；当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时，为ACK集群ID

instanceType.description_en: The type of the instance specified by the collector output. Valid values: elasticsearch and logstash. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance
instanceType.description_zh: 采集器Output指定的实例类型，支持：elasticsearch、logstash。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

kibanaHost.description_en: The public network access address of Kibana after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorElasticsearchForKibana
kibanaHost.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的公网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

machines.description_en: The information about the ECS instances where the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ECSInstanceId
machines.description_zh: 采集器所部署的ECS机器列表信息。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ECSInstanceId时显示

agentStatus.description_en: The status of each collector on the ECS instance. Valid values: heartOk (heartbeat normal), heartLost (heartbeat abnormal), uninstalled (not installed), and failed (installation failed)
agentStatus.description_zh: ECS上各采集器的状态。支持：heartOk（心跳正常）、heartLost（心跳异常）、uninstalled（未安装）和failed（安装失败）

instanceId.description_en: The IDs of the ECS instances

protocol.description_en: The transmission protocol. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS

successPodsCount.description_en: The number of pods from which data is successfully collected in the ACK cluster. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ACKCluster
successPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有成功采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

totalPodsCount.description_en: The total number of pods from which data is collected in the ACK cluster. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachines and type is set to ACKCluster
totalPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

type.description_en:
The type of the machine where the collector is deployed. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorDeployMachine. Valid values:

ECSInstanceId: ECS instance
ACKCluster: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
type.description_zh:
采集器部署的机器类型，当configType为collectorDeployMachine时显示。支持：

ECSInstanceId：ECS实例
ACKCluster：容器Kubernetes集群

userName.description_en: The username used to access the instance specified by the collector output. Default value: elastic. This parameter is displayed when configType is set to collectorTargetInstance or collectorElasticsearchForKibana
userName.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问用户名，默认为elastic。当configType为collectorTargetInstance或collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

gmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the collector was created. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HHMM format, where the suffix indicates the time zone offset
gmtCreatedTime.description_zh: 采集器创建时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HHMM，末尾为时区偏移量

gmtUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the collector was updated. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HHMM format, where the suffix indicates the time zone offset
gmtUpdateTime.description_zh: 采集器更新时间。格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HHMM，末尾为时区偏移量

resId.description_en: The instance ID of the collector

resType.description_en: The type of the collector. Valid values: fileBeat, metricBeat, heartBeat, and audiBeat

resVersion.description_en:
The version of the collector. The supported versions vary based on the type of the machine where the collector is deployed. Valid values:

ECS: 6.8.5_with_community
ACK: 6.8.13_with_community
resVersion.description_zh:
采集器版本。支持的版本与采集器的部署机器类型相关，具体如下：

ECS：6.8.5_with_community
ACK：6.8.13_with_community

status.description_en: The status of the collector. Valid values: activing (activating) and active (activated)
status.description_zh: 采集器状态。支持activing（生效中）和active（已生效）

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the collector resides
vpcId.description_zh: 采集器所在的专有网络ID
